public_rationale: The records support concerns about interconnected financing and financial vulnerability. Research also finds that speculative dynamics differ across firms. Neither establishes the full allegation that hyperscaler and NVIDIA capital, together with credulous reporting, caused a dangerous AI bubble. No reviewed evidence isolates the media contribution. Risk evidence alone is insufficient for a supported verdict, and heterogeneous valuations do not decisively refute the whole claim.
limitations: The factual causal core is narrower than the passage's evaluative language.
The financing assessments include developments after publication.
Statistical signs of exuberance do not by themselves identify the cause of mispricing.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Hyperscalers and NVIDIA used capital and a credulous media to inflate a dangerous, unstable AI bubble.

statement.excerpt: Hyperscalers and NVIDIA have used their massive amounts of capital and a tech and business media incapable of seeing any other reality but the one created for them to inflate a dangerous, unstable and destructive bubble

from_speaker: used their massive amounts of capital
a tech and business media incapable of seeing any other reality
inflate a dangerous, unstable and destructive bubble
our_interpretation: Assess the factual causal core: financing and credulous reporting materially contributed to speculative AI valuations and financial fragility.
Read bubble ordinarily as prices or investment sustained materially beyond plausible underlying economic returns by speculative expectations.
Read the media language as alleging systematic uncritical amplification, not literal incapacity among every journalist.
Treat 'dangerous, unstable and destructive' as claims of material financial vulnerability; do not require an already completed crash or invent a crash deadline.
No particular company spending amount or accounting measure is asserted.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes speculative mispricing or economically unjustified investment and shows that both hyperscaler/NVIDIA financing and uncritical media amplification materially caused it and associated financial fragility.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable valuation and causal evidence establishes that the alleged material contribution from financing and media did not occur, or that the claimed speculative mispricing and fragility were absent in the relevant market.
